disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.awaitingHint: Verdicts not settled yet. The hourly sweep settles most of them; a verdict whose order cannot follow it waits here until you choose what happens.
disputes.dispositionTitle: The order cannot follow this verdict as it is
disputes.caseGoodsMoving: The goods are already on the way. The buyer is refunded in full either way; choose what happens to the goods.
disputes.caseBeforeDelivery: The order is not delivered yet. Choose when the farmer is paid. Paying now is possible only once the goods were picked up.
disputes.disposition_return_to_farmer: Return the goods to the farmer
disputes.dispositionHint_return_to_farmer: The delivery is cancelled and the order closed. The listing stock is not restored; the farmer relists what is still sellable. The trucker is not paid for the trip.
disputes.dispositionHint_delivered_anyway: The delivery counts as delivered and the order is closed.
disputes.dispositionHint_settle_now: The delivery is cancelled and the order closed. The release pays the farmer and, if there is one, the trucker leg. The stock is not restored.
disputes.dispositionHint_wait_for_delivery: Nothing changes now. The farmer is paid once the order is delivered; until then the mismatch alarm keeps firing.

payouts.title: Manual Payouts
payouts.subtitle: Settlements the Telebirr gateway could not make. Pay each leg in the Telebirr merchant portal, then record the portal transaction ID here.
payouts.refMissingHint: Gateway reported paid without a reference. Find it in the portal and record its ID; pay only if it is missing.
payouts.outcomeUnknownHint: Telebirr may already have paid this leg. Search the portal for {gatewayRef}. If it is not there, wait and search again before paying: a payment can show up late. Record its ID if you find it; pay only if it is still missing.
payouts.confirmFound: The portal shows {amount} paid to {phone} under this ID?
payouts.loadFailed: The payout queue could not be loaded. Reload before paying anything.
payouts.deliveredWarning: Delivery was confirmed after this refund was queued. Check with the buyer and the farmer before refunding.
payouts.verdictConflict: The dispute verdict is {verdict}, but this payout goes the other way (its lock was taken before the verdict). Do not pay it: check the escrow history first.

unapplied.title: Unapplied Payments
unapplied.subtitle: Payments Telebirr captured that never reached their order: a cancelled or missing order, a second payment, or a payment that could not be processed. Refund each one in the Telebirr merchant portal, then record the refund here. Recording moves no order and no escrow.
unapplied.empty: No captured payment is waiting for a refund.
unapplied.emptySoFar: None found in this part of the history. Load more to keep searching.
unapplied.paymentUnknown: The payment order ID is not known. Search the portal for checkout {merchOrderId}.
unapplied.reason_no_payment_order_id: Telebirr sent no payment order ID
unapplied.reason_replay_exhausted: Processing gave up after repeated tries
unapplied.error_ESCROW_036: This reference conflicts with one already recorded for this order. Reload and check.
unapplied.capturedUnknown: Not on record. Read the amount in the portal.
unapplied.mayStillApply: Telebirr may still deliver this payment to its order. Do not refund it yet.
unapplied.confirmRefund: You refunded {amount} for payment {payment} in the portal, under {ref}?
unapplied.recordedUnchecked: Refund recorded. The captured amount was not on record, so the amount was not checked.
unapplied.loadFailed: The unapplied payments could not be loaded. Reload before refunding anything.

fraud.title: Fraud Review
fraud.confirmReject: Rejecting suspends the account and signs the user out.
fraud.result_approve: Signal approved. It no longer counts toward this user's risk score.
fraud.result_reject: Signal rejected. User {userId} is suspended (fraud confirmed).
fraud.result_sessionsNotEnded: The sign-in service was not updated, so the user may stay signed in until the session expires.
fraud.result_whitelist: Signal whitelisted. This user's soft signals (GPS and price) do not count until {date}.
fraud.openEscrowsHint: Nothing was held now. The next settlement sweep holds each of these escrows when it comes due.
fraud.noOpenEscrows: This user has no open escrows.
fraud.openEscrowsIncomplete: This list may be incomplete. Check the Escrows page.
